title: Item
description: A single article/SKU's physical master facts. Referenced by id from OrderOrchestration-as-Code's material_request.item_id and Allocation-as-Code's search_rule.applies_to.item_id.

owner.description: Stock owner of this item: an id from company.yaml owners. Each item belongs to exactly one owner; the same physical goods of two owners are two items. Omit to inherit the category's default_attributes.owner. Only allowed when the company declares owners.

default_uom.description: References an id in elements/uom_types.yaml - the unit material_request.quantity is expressed in when no other uom is specified. Omit to inherit the category's default_attributes.default_uom (see tools/compile.py) - required for at least one of the two to be set.

storage_condition.description: References an id in elements/storage_conditions.yaml (e.g. 'chilled'). Omit to inherit the category's default_attributes.storage_condition; omitted on both levels = no requirement.

tracking.description: Lot, expiry and serial obligations. Any field omitted here is inherited from the category's default_attributes.tracking, field by field (see tools/compile.py).
